files.review: Actual default Live2D opening image: character and skip control visible, no blank image. This frame precedes entry and does not prove the full UX task.

Actual welcome team grid and entry buttons visible; lower rows continue below the captured viewport. 65 actors is a receipt count; this pixel sample does not establish all 65 simultaneously readable or scrolling usability.

Workplace scene and state labels visible. Company owner gold plaque intersects the entity-consistency-manager label. Expanded mate covers several lower-right labels/actors, including conversion designer and Lu Jibai. The ready/18-actor receipt does not establish no visual obstruction.

Actual report-stage scene occupies upper portion of the scene box; lower roughly 40 percent is a flat black region. Team figures are very small and compressed in the upper scene; expanded mate covers lower-right area. Exact rendering cause and clickable reachability unverified; ready/65-actor receipt is retained separately.
Safe vector opening character and skip control visible; the image is dark but not blank. No full accessibility or task-flow claim from one frame.

Safe team grid and continue/enter controls visible. Lower team rows lie outside this captured viewport; 65 actors is separately the JSON count, not proof of all simultaneously visible or keyboard/scroll reachability.

2D workplace uses a bright isometric floor with readable visible labels. Expanded mate image covers several lower-right labels/agents; close/hide controls are visible. This is observed occlusion; actual repeated close/reopen and reachability not tested by this pixel review.

2D fallback stage is a central manager silhouette surrounded by blue satellite dots. No report-stage-3d lower black rectangle in this vector fallback frame. Expanded mate covers lower-right area; satellite selection/reachability unverified.
